text:
jia: FYI we're noticing sustained GPU slot reservation failures during large batch embedding jobs in eu-south starting ~08:15 UTC. sched_errors spiked from 0.3% -> 4.8%. logs show 'nofits' and a lot of preemption churn.

omar: I saw that. Heapster telemetry shows a handful of racks with high slab fragmentation + one rack with thermal throttles. Could be both allocation packing + a noisy tenant holding long-running ephemeral slices.

jia: Which rack? can we isolate?

omar: eu-s-07 reports HWM slab fragmentation 87% and continuous preempt traces. `dmesg` on the node shows several GPU driver resets but no full OOM.

lucy: That rack also hosts a couple of legacy dedicated pools we recently converted to fractional dedicated. Might be fragmentation from mixed vGPU and full GPU workloads.

kevin: If fractional carved slices are mixing with full-GPU tenants you'll see allocator 'nofits' because of packing constraints. Suggest: 1) soft-drain the high-frag rack; 2) redirect new fractional allocations to warm-pool in eu-s-02; 3) run slab-compaction job (evict small idle tasks) during low traffic window. Cost hit minimal if we use warm-pool.

jia: I can kick soft-drain but worried about preempting latency-sensitive customers. Any safe-window?

omar: 09:00-09:10 UTC is low on traffic historically. We can rotate a single host at a time to minimize disruption. Also propose enabling transient coalesce (allocator flag) so small fragments can be coalesced for the next 30m.

lucy: Coalesce flag already exists but is off in eu-s because of prior regressions. If we flip it for one host we should be able to reduce fragmentation by ~20%. Needs watch.

infra-bot: scheduled action created: action-83492 by kevin at 1755560025.

kevin: I'll prepare a short runbook: 1) set allocator flag `transient-coalesce=true` on host eu-s-07-03; 2) soft-drain eu-s-07-03; 3) run slab-compact job `./tools/slab-compact --rack eu-s-07 --concurrency 1`; 4) observe sched_errors for 15m; 5) revert if regressions.

jia: go ahead. Make sure oncall aware and include contact list for affected tenants so Customer Success can notify.

omar: started compaction; initial telemetry shows fragmentation dropping from 87% -> 66% on host after first pass. sched_errors trending down to 1.6%.

lucy: Nice. Any impact on inter-zone egress or KV cache churn?

omar: minimal. main win from reduced preempt churn. No spike in egress.

kevin: rolling the transient-coalesce to the rest of the rack in 5 min. Watch for any CPU load increases on allocator-control plane (compaction does metadata ops).

infra-bot: notice: transient-coalesce flag toggled on host eu-s-07-03 by kevin at 1755560075.

jia: Good job. Post-mortem items: 1) revisit fractional carve policy for mixed vGPU/full-GPU hosts; 2) consider automated slab-compaction trigger when fragmentation >75% and sched_errors >1%; 3) review conversion playbook for dedicated->fractional to avoid leftover constraints.

kevin: I'll draft the follow-ups and estimate cost / risk tradeoffs for running compaction more aggressively.

lucy: Also add a guardrail: prevent legacy dedicated pools from being auto-converted on racks with >60% fragmentation.

infra-bot: incident closed by jia at 1755560190. Summary posted to #incidents.

jia: closing thread. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
